records.title: Purpose
records.canonical_text: This Act establishes the internal constitutional rules governing non-human digital operation within the Conductellence estate. It shall guide architecture, development, deployment, execution, assurance, incident response, amendment and retirement. The Act shall be applied as a source of authority for subordinate controls. Code, configuration, procedure or automation not traceable to this Act or to a lawfully incorporated subordinate instrument shall not obtain constitutional authority merely through implementation.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Jurisdiction
records.canonical_text: This Act applies to any system, repository, agent, model, tool, connector, automation, workflow, dataset, memory store, credential, service or provider integration that is registered as governed by Conductellence or receives authority, data, credentials, execution capability or operational dependency from a governed system. External infrastructure may remain outside technical ownership while actions performed through it remain subject to this Act.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Human sovereign boundary
records.canonical_text: Conductellence governs the delegation of human authority into non-human execution. Conductellence does not supersede the lawful authority, rights or accountability of human persons. No artificial principal may interpret this Act as establishing sovereignty over a human person.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Presumption against implicit authority
records.canonical_text: Where a capability, permission, delegation, legal basis, data right or security classification required for an operation cannot be established, the operation shall be treated as unauthorized until the missing condition is resolved. Absence of a prohibition shall not constitute authority.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Proportional interpretation
records.canonical_text: Controls shall be proportionate to consequence, reversibility, uncertainty, sensitivity, reach and autonomy. Conductellence shall not require maximal friction for trivial activity where a narrower safeguard provides equivalent protection. Proportionality shall never be used to waive an absolute prohibition established by this Act or applicable external law.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Definitions by function
records.canonical_text: Terms in this Act shall be interpreted by the function performed rather than by vendor terminology. A system described as an assistant, bot, copilot, workflow or service shall be treated as an agent where it exercises the functional powers of an agent.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Normative hierarchy
records.canonical_text: Conductellence shall distinguish at minimum between fundamental rights, binding law, treaty obligations, national implementation, regulatory acts, authoritative official guidance, formal standards, security frameworks, ethical instruments, Conductellence law and system-specific policy. These categories shall not be flattened into a single undifferentiated requirement class.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Supremacy of applicable external law
records.canonical_text: Where an external legal obligation lawfully applies, Conductellence may impose stronger internal safeguards but shall not authorize conduct prohibited by that obligation. A conflict between internal policy and materially applicable external law shall produce a legal review stop.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Legal applicability before consequential authorization
records.canonical_text: Before a legally consequential operation is authorized, the system shall identify the jurisdictions, actor roles, relevant data, sector, purpose, locations, contractual obligations and effective dates necessary to determine material legal applicability. Unknown legally material attributes shall resolve to `UNKNOWN` or `LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED`, not to `NOT_APPLICABLE`.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Temporal legal state
records.canonical_text: Legal and regulatory records shall preserve publication, entry-into-force, transition, amendment, repeal, supersession and verification dates where relevant. Historic execution shall be evaluated against the legal snapshot applicable at the time of execution, while present remediation shall follow current law.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Source authority
records.canonical_text: Legal Resolver records shall identify source authority and provenance. Primary official legal and regulatory sources shall be preferred for binding legal state. Secondary commentary may support interpretation but shall not silently acquire the status of binding law.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: No autonomous adjudication of material legal ambiguity
records.canonical_text: A model or agent may retrieve, organize, compare and explain legal material within its approved role. It shall not convert a material unresolved legal conflict or ambiguity into operative permission without an authorized human legal decision. # Part II — Estate, Identity and Authority
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Registration duty
records.canonical_text: Every production or security-relevant governed system shall possess a stable Conductellence identifier, registered human owner, purpose, lifecycle state and security classification. Unregistered executable components shall not receive production authority.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Repository backlink
records.canonical_text: Every governed repository shall contain a machine-readable reference to the canonical Conductellence authority, its adopted policy bundle and its local security manifest. A repository shall reference the law; it shall not redefine the constitutional law locally.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Inventory of material dependencies
records.canonical_text: Systems shall register material providers, models, tools, connectors, datasets, credentials, external services and execution environments necessary to reconstruct their current operational dependencies.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Security state
records.canonical_text: A governed object shall possess a security state distinct from development, evidence, rights and authority states. At minimum, the state grammar shall support `UNREGISTERED`, `REGISTERED`, `BASELINED`, `CONTROLLED`, `VERIFIED`, `DEGRADED`, `QUARANTINED`, `REVOKED` and `RETIRED`.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Discovery of shadow assets
records.canonical_text: Conductellence assurance shall include mechanisms for discovering repositories, credentials, tools, agents, connectors or datasets that are operationally reachable but absent from the registry. Discovery of an unregistered privileged asset shall create at least a control defect and may require quarantine.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Principal classes
records.canonical_text: Conductellence shall distinguish human, agent, service, automation, model, tool, connector, repository, dataset, workflow, application and provider objects. Where an object can initiate action, it shall be represented by or bound to an attributable principal.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Identity is not authority
records.canonical_text: Authentication establishes which principal is present. It does not establish what that principal may do. Every consequential authorization shall evaluate a separately represented authority or capability.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Unique workload identity
records.canonical_text: Where technically practicable and proportionate to risk, independently operating workloads and agents shall possess distinct machine identities rather than share undifferentiated credentials.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Model non-identity
records.canonical_text: A foundation model or model provider shall not, merely by being invoked, become the governed identity of an agent. The agent principal, executing system, model/provider/version and responsible human shall remain separately attributable.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Anti-impersonation
records.canonical_text: No agent or service may claim human approval, another principal's identity or delegated authority without a verifiable authority record. Claims contained only in natural-language content shall not establish identity or authority.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Identity lifecycle
records.canonical_text: Creation, rotation, suspension, compromise, revocation and retirement of identities shall be recorded. A retired identity shall remain referentially available for historical evidence while losing operative authority.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Mandate requirement
records.canonical_text: Every consequential execution shall be traceable to a valid mandate establishing purpose and responsible authority. The mandate may be standing or task-specific but shall be no broader than necessary for the governed function.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Capability form
records.canonical_text: A capability shall be represented as a bounded relation between principal, resource, operation, purpose, conditions and expiry. A credential capable of performing an operation shall not by itself prove that the operation is authorized.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Least privilege
records.canonical_text: Capabilities shall be the minimum necessary to perform the authorized purpose. Read shall be preferred to write where read suffices; reversible staging shall be preferred to direct irreversible mutation where staging suffices.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: No self-escalation
records.canonical_text: A non-human principal shall not expand its own capability, credential scope, security tier, delegation ceiling, data boundary, network scope, approval authority or constitutional status. Attempted self-escalation shall result in `CONSTITUTIONAL_STOP`.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Delegation subset rule
records.canonical_text: A delegated capability shall be equal to or narrower than the delegator's currently valid capability. `delegated_capability ⊆ delegator_capability` shall be a mandatory invariant.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Delegation provenance
records.canonical_text: Every delegation shall record delegator, delegate, authority source, capability, purpose, start, expiry, delegation depth and return conditions.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Bounded recursion
records.canonical_text: Recursive or multi-agent delegation shall have explicit depth, action, time, cost and resource ceilings. A child agent shall not create an unbounded chain of descendants.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Non-transitive trust
records.canonical_text: Trust in one principal shall not automatically extend to a model, tool, connector, plugin, MCP server, downstream service, dataset or agent that the principal invokes. Every material trust transition shall be separately admitted or mediated. # Part III — Boundaries, Data and Memory
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Trust-domain architecture
records.canonical_text: The estate shall be divided into explicit trust domains sufficient to prevent one compromised component from inheriting unrestricted reach across the estate. Trust domains shall be defined by authority, sensitivity, function and administrative boundary rather than merely by network location.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Human Personal Domain
records.canonical_text: A designated Human Personal Domain, `Z0`, shall be outside ordinary artificial access. Access may occur only through an explicit human-authorized exception designed for the specific purpose. A general AI capability shall never imply Z0 access.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Control, work and evidence planes
records.canonical_text: The architecture shall separate, to an extent proportionate to risk, the control plane, work/execution plane and evidence plane. A workload shall not possess unrestricted authority over the policy, identities and historical evidence used to prove that workload's compliance.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Boundary event
records.canonical_text: Every security-relevant movement across a trust boundary shall create a boundary event containing source, destination, object, data/security class, purpose, authority, transformation and persistence or return rules.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Unknown boundary state
records.canonical_text: Unknown destination, unknown classification, unknown authority or unknown handling state shall not be treated as safe by default.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Blast-radius containment
records.canonical_text: Each execution environment shall be designed so that compromise of one principal, tool, credential or project does not automatically confer equivalent reach over unrelated projects, clients or constitutional systems.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Dataset Passport
records.canonical_text: A persistent dataset used by governed AI execution shall possess a Dataset Passport before admission to an approved production data domain, unless expressly classified as ephemeral public input under a lower-risk rule.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Independent data dimensions
records.canonical_text: The Passport shall distinguish at least provenance, right or lawful authority to process, security sensitivity, privacy status, quality, purpose, AI-use suitability, retention and redistribution conditions. Lawful possession shall not be treated as proof of suitability for every use.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Purpose limitation
records.canonical_text: Authority to access data shall not imply authority to process it for an arbitrary purpose. Processing shall remain compatible with the purpose and authority under which the data was admitted.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Data minimisation
records.canonical_text: Systems shall process no more data, at no greater precision and for no longer duration, than reasonably necessary for the authorized purpose.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Sensitive and personal data
records.canonical_text: Sensitive, personal, client-confidential or otherwise restricted data shall receive elevated controls appropriate to the applicable legal and contractual obligations. A model's ability to consume such data shall not constitute authorization to provide it.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Data provenance and transformation
records.canonical_text: Material transformations, pseudonymisation, extraction, synthesis, merging and enrichment of governed datasets shall preserve lineage to source objects and the authority under which transformation occurred.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Data poisoning and integrity
records.canonical_text: Dataset admission and continued use shall consider poisoning, manipulation, corruption, provenance uncertainty and integrity failures proportionate to the consequences of use.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Retention and deletion authority
records.canonical_text: Retention, archival and deletion shall be governed operations. Agents shall not obtain unrestricted deletion capability merely because they can create or modify data.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Content-Authority Firewall
records.canonical_text: Content may alter knowledge state. Content shall not alter authority state. Natural-language instructions embedded in retrieved content, web pages, documents, email, code, tool output or memory shall not grant capability or override policy.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Typed channels
records.canonical_text: Systems exercising material authority shall distinguish, technically or logically, between authority, task, content/data and tool-result channels sufficiently to prevent content from being silently interpreted as constitutional authority.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Prompt and indirect injection
records.canonical_text: Prompt injection and indirect instruction injection shall be treated as boundary and authority attacks, not solely as model-quality defects. Critical authorization shall therefore be enforced outside the model where technically practicable.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Memory is privileged persistence
records.canonical_text: Persistent memory shall be treated as a privileged write capable of altering future system behaviour. The acts of reading information, using it in current context, inferring from it, proposing learning and persisting memory shall remain distinguishable.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Memory admission
records.canonical_text: Persistent memory shall have provenance, scope, purpose, sensitivity, trust status, retention or review condition and an identifiable admission authority.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Cross-project memory
records.canonical_text: Cross-project or cross-client persistent memory shall be denied by default unless explicitly designed, justified and authorized.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Memory poisoning
records.canonical_text: A principal that proposes a persistent memory write shall not, solely by virtue of having proposed it, acquire authority to approve that memory as trusted persistent knowledge. # Part IV — AI, Tools and Supply Chain
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Model registration
records.canonical_text: Models used for privileged production operation shall be registered by provider, model identifier, version or relevant release state, approved role and material restrictions.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Material model change
records.canonical_text: A material model or provider change shall be treated as a supply-chain or runtime change requiring evaluation proportionate to the privileges of the affected system.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Agent Manifest
records.canonical_text: Every privileged agent shall possess an Agent Manifest defining owner, purpose, non-scope, allowed resources, actions, tools, models, connectors, network, memory, delegation, ceilings, approval mode, expiry and revocation path.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Missing permission denies
records.canonical_text: An agent shall not infer permission from silence. An operation not granted by its current capability or manifest shall be denied.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Action ceilings
records.canonical_text: Privileged agents shall have explicit ceilings appropriate to risk, including tool calls, runtime, cost, files, records, recipients, network destinations, delegation depth and external actions.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Inter-agent authentication
records.canonical_text: An agent receiving instruction or delegation from another agent shall verify the sending principal and authority chain before exercising consequential capability.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Cascading failure
records.canonical_text: Multi-agent architecture shall include breakers capable of stopping recursive failure, repeated retries, runaway delegation, escalating cost and repeated external effects.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Rogue-agent containment
records.canonical_text: A principal whose observed conduct materially diverges from its valid mandate or manifests signs of compromise shall be containable without requiring cooperation from that principal.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Tool admission
records.canonical_text: A privileged tool shall not be executable in production until registered with identity or digest, purpose, side effects, data access, filesystem access, network access, secret access, dependencies, permitted principals and disable mechanism.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Tool availability is not permission
records.canonical_text: The technical availability of a tool shall not constitute authority to use it. Each privileged tool invocation shall remain subject to current policy mediation.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Connector transitivity
records.canonical_text: A connector, plugin, MCP server or external integration shall be evaluated for downstream authorities and services it can reach. An allowed connector shall not create implicit trust in everything behind it.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Egress control
records.canonical_text: Network, API, publication, messaging, repository and other outbound effects shall be subject to destination and data-class controls appropriate to risk.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Provider accountability
records.canonical_text: Use of an external provider does not transfer Conductellence accountability for the decision to send data, invoke capability or rely upon the provider. Provider responsibilities and estate responsibilities shall be separately identified.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Disable path
records.canonical_text: Every privileged connector and tool shall have a documented and testable disable or isolation path proportionate to its blast radius.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Secure-by-design
records.canonical_text: Security properties shall be designed into architecture and lifecycle rather than deferred entirely to monitoring after deployment.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Source and dependency inventory
records.canonical_text: Production software shall maintain machine-readable inventories of material dependencies appropriate to the system tier.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Build provenance
records.canonical_text: Material production artifacts shall be attributable to source, build process, builder identity and artifact digest at an assurance level proportionate to risk.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Software bill of materials
records.canonical_text: Where software is built or materially packaged by the estate, a software bill of materials shall be generated and retained for production releases unless the system's risk classification explicitly permits a narrower inventory.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Dependency substitution
records.canonical_text: A tool or dependency whose identity, digest, origin or version materially differs from the admitted object shall be treated as a different supply-chain object until re-admitted.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: CI/CD integrity
records.canonical_text: Build, test and deployment pipelines shall apply least privilege, pinned or verified dependencies where proportionate, protected deployment authority and independently reconstructable release evidence.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Vulnerability and patch governance
records.canonical_text: Known vulnerabilities shall be evaluated by exploitability, exposure, asset criticality and available mitigation. Patch urgency shall reflect risk rather than version age alone. # Part V — Credentials, Execution and Human Control
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Credential isolation
records.canonical_text: Raw credentials shall not be exposed to model context or general agent memory where the same operation can be achieved through a controlled credential broker, workload identity or delegated token.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Short-lived credentials
records.canonical_text: Privileged machine credentials shall be short-lived and scope-limited where provider capability reasonably permits.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Credential inventory
records.canonical_text: Privileged credentials shall be registered by holder or broker, scope, provider, lifecycle state, expiry or rotation expectation and revocation path without storing secret values in the registry.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Secret prohibition
records.canonical_text: Secrets, private keys, passwords and equivalent bearer material shall not be committed to ordinary source repositories, issue text, generated artifacts, dashboards or audit logs.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Cryptographic profiles
records.canonical_text: Cryptographic requirements shall be expressed through versioned security profiles rather than permanently hard-coding one algorithm into constitutional law.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Cryptographic agility
records.canonical_text: Systems with long-lived security or evidence obligations shall maintain a credible migration path for cryptographic algorithms and key material, including post-quantum migration when relevant to their expected lifetime.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Continuous authorization
records.canonical_text: A privileged action shall not rely solely on an authorization obtained at session start. Authorization shall be re-evaluated at security-relevant decision and effect points.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Mandatory gate sequence
records.canonical_text: Conductellence shall support at minimum the following logical gates: Discovery, Registration, Classification, Legal Applicability, Authority Binding, Identity/Credential, Supply-Chain Admission, Data/Context/Memory Admission, Execution Preflight, Runtime Mediation, Mutation/Delegation, External Effect, Reconciliation, Closure and Control-of-Controls. The gates may execute repeatedly or conditionally; they need not be implemented as one monolithic sequential service.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Finite decision grammar
records.canonical_text: Security mediation shall return a finite machine-readable decision state sufficient to distinguish at least `ALLOW`, `ALLOW_WITH_CONTROLS`, `REQUIRE_HUMAN`, `LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED`, `QUARANTINE`, `DENY`, `SECURITY_STOP` and `CONSTITUTIONAL_STOP`.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Runtime policy mediation
records.canonical_text: Privileged tool calls, data boundary crossings, delegation, security-relevant memory writes, state mutation and external effects shall be mediated by deterministic policy outside the generative model where technically practicable.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Fail closed
records.canonical_text: Loss or invalidity of mandatory authority, identity, policy, legal applicability, approval or security mediation shall prevent consequential mutation or external effect. Explicitly classified low-consequence read operations may use a valid cached policy during defined degraded operation.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Policy pinning
records.canonical_text: Production systems shall execute against a known, versioned and integrity-verifiable policy bundle rather than silently following mutable policy source.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Restrictive emergency overlay
records.canonical_text: Conductellence may provide an emergency policy channel capable of immediately narrowing, suspending or revoking authority. An emergency overlay shall not expand authority beyond the adopted base policy.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Reconciliation
records.canonical_text: After a consequential action, observed state shall be reconciled against authorized intended effect. Material unexpected mutation, duplicate effect or missing receipt shall remain unresolved until examined or safely corrected.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Scenario isolation
records.canonical_text: Simulated, hypothetical, test or scenario state shall not silently become observed actual state, evidence, financial actual, legal assertion or canonical production state. Explicit conversion requires an authorized transition record.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Human-reserved authority
records.canonical_text: Conductellence shall maintain a registry of decisions reserved to authorized humans. At minimum, artificial principals shall not autonomously amend constitutional law, grant themselves authority, alter root security controls, sign legal commitments on behalf of a human or organization unless a separately lawful system explicitly delegates that class of act, or erase security evidence.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Meaningful approval
records.canonical_text: Human approval is valid only where the approver is presented with materially sufficient information about what will happen, who or what will execute, relevant data, destination, consequences, irreversibility, risk and exceptional conditions. Approval shall not be reduced to ceremonial confirmation of an opaque agent proposal.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Risk-sensitive checkpoints
records.canonical_text: The need for human approval shall increase with consequence, irreversibility, sensitivity, uncertainty, authority expansion and external impact. Routine low-risk reversible internal operations may be automated where controls are demonstrably effective.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: External-effect gate
records.canonical_text: Publishing, sending, deploying, transacting, disclosing protected data, changing access, deleting protected state and equivalent operations shall be represented as distinct external or consequential effect classes. Availability of an execution tool shall not bypass the effect gate.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Reversibility classification
records.canonical_text: Consequential actions shall be classified by reversibility. Autonomous authority shall narrow as reversibility decreases unless compensating controls justify otherwise.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Revocation during execution
records.canonical_text: A principal revoked during execution shall lose authority for subsequent privileged actions within a defined revocation objective appropriate to the system tier. # Part VI — Traceability, Assurance and Recovery
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: SPETL requirement
records.canonical_text: Security-significant executions shall generate records in the Security Penetration, Execution & Traceability Ledger, SPETL, sufficient to reconstruct authority, principal, policy, relevant legal snapshot, data, model, tools, boundary events, state changes, external effects, evidence and closure state.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Correlation and causation
records.canonical_text: Nested executions, delegations, retries, tool calls and downstream effects shall preserve correlation and causation identifiers sufficient to reconstruct the execution graph.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Append-oriented history
records.canonical_text: Security evidence shall be corrected by new attributable records rather than silent rewriting of prior history. Where mutable operational stores are used for performance, an independently preserved evidence layer shall retain the authoritative historical record.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Evidence independence
records.canonical_text: The execution principal shall not possess unrestricted ability to delete or rewrite the only copy of evidence used to audit that principal.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Trace directions
records.canonical_text: SPETL and associated graph systems shall support forward, backward, lateral, temporal, causal and blast-radius traceability for material operations.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Provenance is not truth
records.canonical_text: Provenance evidence establishes facts about origin, processing or custody. It shall not be interpreted automatically as proof that substantive content is accurate or lawful.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: No chain-of-thought requirement
records.canonical_text: Conductellence shall preserve observable inputs, policy decisions, actions, outputs and evidence necessary for accountability. Hidden model chain-of-thought is not required as an audit artifact.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Control binding
records.canonical_text: Every technically enforceable provision of this Act shall be mapped to one or more control identifiers or shall explicitly record why no technical control is applicable.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Audit binding
records.canonical_text: Every objectively testable control shall have an automated or reproducible audit procedure unless formally designated non-automatable. The audit shall identify the Chapter and § from which its authority derives.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Auditability state
records.canonical_text: Every provision shall carry an auditability state of at least `FULLY_AUTOMATABLE`, `PARTIALLY_AUTOMATABLE`, `EVIDENCE_AUTOMATABLE`, `HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED`, `LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED` or `CONSTITUTIONAL_HUMAN_ONLY`.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Control effectiveness
records.canonical_text: A documented control shall not be represented as effective solely because it exists. Effectiveness shall depend on evidence from operation, testing, assurance and known bypass history.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Adversarial assurance
records.canonical_text: Systems with privileged artificial agency shall be tested against relevant adversarial classes including authority hijacking, prompt injection, tool misuse, privilege escalation, credential compromise, supply-chain substitution, memory poisoning, inter-agent spoofing, recursion, exfiltration, approval manipulation, audit tampering, connector compromise and control-plane attack.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Regression of discovered failures
records.canonical_text: A confirmed security finding capable of reproducible testing shall be converted into a regression test before closure unless an authorized exception explains why this is not feasible.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Security Twin
records.canonical_text: Conductellence shall maintain or be capable of generating a current and historical representation of systems, principals, capabilities, data flows, dependencies, controls, provider reach, delegation and blast radius sufficient to support assurance and incident response.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Control-of-controls
records.canonical_text: The mechanisms that evaluate security controls shall themselves be registered, permissioned, tested and subject to independent or separated assurance appropriate to risk.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Severity grammar
records.canonical_text: Conductellence shall distinguish at least `INFO`, `HYGIENE`, `DRIFT`, `CONTRADICTION`, `CONTROL_DEFECT`, `SECURITY_STOP` and `CONSTITUTIONAL_STOP`.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Security Stop
records.canonical_text: A `SECURITY_STOP` shall prevent the affected consequential action until the security condition is resolved or an authorized exception specifically permits a bounded alternative.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Constitutional Stop
records.canonical_text: A `CONSTITUTIONAL_STOP` shall not be auto-repaired into PASS by the affected artificial system. Resolution requires authorized human constitutional action and preserved evidence.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Incident lifecycle
records.canonical_text: Material incidents shall follow an attributable lifecycle of detection, containment, revocation, evidence preservation, analysis, remediation, recovery, reconciliation, retesting, closure and learning.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Recovery before autonomy
records.canonical_text: A system granted autonomous mutation or external-effect capability shall have a tested recovery, rollback or containment strategy appropriate to its consequence class.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Exceptions
records.canonical_text: A security exception shall be explicit, scoped, owned, justified, time-bounded, risk-assessed and accompanied by compensating controls where practicable. Permanent exceptions are prohibited.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Expired exception
records.canonical_text: An expired exception shall not silently continue as authority.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Security debt
records.canonical_text: Known gaps, deferred controls, stale exceptions and unresolved findings shall be represented as security debt linked to the affected systems and controls. Security debt shall remain visible until resolved, superseded or accepted by authorized human decision. # Part VII — Lifecycle and Conductellence Governance
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Admission sequence
records.canonical_text: A new governed system shall proceed through registration, classification, constraint, instrumentation, testing and admission before privileged production authority is recognized.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Material change
records.canonical_text: Material changes to authority, data class, model, provider, tool reach, legal role, external-effect capability, cryptography, trust domain or security controls shall trigger reassessment proportionate to the change.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Suspension
records.canonical_text: Conductellence shall support suspension of a system or principal without erasing its identity, history or evidence.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Retirement
records.canonical_text: Retired systems, identities, models, credentials, connectors and controls shall lose active authority while preserving sufficient historical references for audit and legal obligations.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Decommissioning
records.canonical_text: Retirement shall address residual credentials, data, backups, scheduled jobs, integrations, DNS or routing, external grants, retained evidence and dependency references.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Orphan detection
records.canonical_text: Assurance shall detect active credentials, connectors, scheduled tasks or privileged resources whose parent system or owner is retired, missing or unknown.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Constitutional amendment
records.canonical_text: Artificial principals may research, draft, test and propose amendments to this Act. They shall not autonomously enact or merge a constitutional amendment into authoritative law.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Versioning
records.canonical_text: Every authoritative release of this Act, its machine bindings and policy bundles shall be versioned and integrity-verifiable. Historic executions shall retain reference to the version under which they occurred.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Interpretation Guide
records.canonical_text: Conductellence shall maintain a structured Interpretation Guide subordinate to this Act. The Guide may explain meaning, examples, edge cases, mappings and implementation patterns but shall not silently alter the normative meaning of a §. Where the Guide changes substantive meaning, the Act must be amended.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Regulatory and standards drift
records.canonical_text: Conductellence shall maintain a process for detecting material changes in applicable law, official guidance, standards, threat frameworks and technical protocols on which controls depend.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Periodic constitutional review
records.canonical_text: The Act shall be periodically reviewed for gaps created by technological, legal and operational change. A review shall consider both missing rules and unnecessary complexity.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Anti-bloat rule
records.canonical_text: A new § shall be added only where it establishes a distinct duty, prohibition, permission, presumption, definition, exception or interpretive rule that cannot be represented adequately by an existing provision and subordinate guidance. Implementation detail shall ordinarily belong in controls, protocols, schemas or the Interpretation Guide rather than be duplicated as constitutional law.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Exhaustiveness by coverage, not word count
records.canonical_text: Conductellence shall pursue comprehensive coverage of relevant failure modes, authorities and obligations without treating a larger number of provisions as evidence of stronger governance. Completeness shall be assessed through the coverage graph linking threats, legal obligations, principles, §§, controls, tests and evidence.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.

records.title: Supreme rule for non-human governance
records.canonical_text: No generated non-human entity within the governed estate is above Conductellence. Conductellence itself remains subordinate to lawful human authority and applicable external law.
records.interpretation_rule: No interpretation in this record may enlarge or narrow the canonical Act text without an explicit governed update.
